requirements.quoted_clause_text:
Clause ID: CPB-R4-01

Every local authority path is resolved as a primary unnamed stream. Stream selectors, reparse substitutions, and ungoverned enumeration are rejected before authority bytes are accepted.
requirements.requirement_interpretation: Authority is accepted only from an exact physical file and directory identity held through governed use. Exact retained clause CPB-R4-01.
requirements.required_positive_behavior: Open the fixed object without following reparse points; verify final NT path, volume, file ID, owner, ACL, link count, streams, size and bytes from the held handle.
requirements.required_rejection_behavior: Reject aliases, reparse traversal, unexpected links or streams, path-case collisions, alternate volumes, stale copies and identity changes between measurement and use.
requirements.required_evidence: Held-handle identity, final path, volume serial, file ID, owner/ACL, link/stream inventory, size, SHA-256 and before/use/after identity evidence.
requirements.required_side_effects: Only the explicitly authorized read or immutable install action may occur.
requirements.forbidden_side_effects: No authority-store mutation, alternate-root selection, path reopening after validation or production-root write.
requirements.durability_obligation: Installed authority identities and root ACLs remain fixed and publicly inventory-verifiable.
requirements.restart_retry_replay_obligation: Restart reopens and revalidates the same fixed physical identities; substitution, rollback and stale copies fail closed.
requirements.reconciliation_obligation: Candidate and fresh evidence must bind distinct run files while resolving the same governed installed identities.

requirements.quoted_clause_text:
Clause ID: CPB-R4-02

Every SEPARATE_AND_BIND obligation derives its independent-review requirement from immutable rule, policy, role, evidence, enumeration, and review authorities. Self-review is unrepresentable.
requirements.requirement_interpretation: Independent roles and evidence classes must be separated by both semantics and OS-enforced capabilities. Exact retained clause CPB-R4-02.
requirements.required_positive_behavior: Use distinct restricted principals and disjoint readable/writable roots for execution, observation, comparison, signing and upgrade authority.
requirements.required_rejection_behavior: Reject self-review, signer-token inheritance, expectation access by actual producers, shared signing capability and caller-controlled authority substitution.
requirements.required_evidence: Service SIDs, token groups, privilege sets, ACLs, access-denied probes, process parentage and per-role file-access evidence.
requirements.required_side_effects: Each role writes only its narrow append-only spool or authority store.
requirements.forbidden_side_effects: No child key use, ledger/trust/receipt write, signer impersonation, repository write or interactive logon.
requirements.durability_obligation: Principal, privilege and ACL registries are content-bound and rechecked at service start and terminal issuance.
requirements.restart_retry_replay_obligation: Restart preserves distinct principals and denies inherited signer capabilities.
requirements.reconciliation_obligation: Reconciliation resolves independently produced graphs and rejects shared or synthetic provenance.

requirements.quoted_clause_text:

Every authority family has a closed Draft 2020-12 schema. Canonical loading rejects duplicate keys, floats, noncanonical bytes, and every non-NFC key or value before schema and semantic evaluation.
requirements.requirement_interpretation: Every authority and IPC object has one strict byte representation and one closed typed meaning. Exact retained clause CPB-R4-03.

requirements.required_rejection_behavior: Reject duplicate keys, coercion, floats, null/absent confusion, unknown fields, noncanonical bytes, trailing data, partial or multiple objects and normalization collisions.
requirements.required_evidence: Raw frame bytes, parse-stage classification, canonical round-trip identity, schema identity and semantic-validation trace.
requirements.required_side_effects: A valid request may reach only its allowlisted operation.
requirements.forbidden_side_effects: Malformed or ambiguous input causes no authority, ledger, receipt, trust or checkpoint effect.
requirements.durability_obligation: Canonical bytes and their hashes are stored with every durable transaction.
requirements.restart_retry_replay_obligation: Retry compares exact canonical request bytes; a reused identity with different bytes conflicts.
requirements.reconciliation_obligation: Only canonical, schema-valid, semantically valid evidence locators enter comparison or reconciliation.

requirements.quoted_clause_text:

requirements.forbidden_side_effects: No deletion, rewrite, truncation, ambiguous rejection-after-commit or mutable-cache authority.

requirements.restart_retry_replay_obligation: Replay advances stale checkpoints, aborts incomplete reservations append-only and returns identical committed responses.
requirements.reconciliation_obligation: Only committed, nonrevoked current receipts may be reconciled; later classification is explicit and signed.

requirements.restart_retry_replay_obligation: Restart reproduces the same classifications and prevents reuse of terminally invalid history.
requirements.reconciliation_obligation: Historical inputs are accepted only when their deterministic class permits reconciliation under the resolved version.

Observer verification loads its immutable event source and proves that source belongs to the accepted freeze receipt, freeze authority, timestamp authority, and attempt within the authorized sequence and time window.

requirements.reconciliation_obligation: Candidate and fresh observations must be independently derived, complete and provenance-disjoint.
